facts.fact: Markdown versions of documentation pages on learn.chatgpt.com are available by appending .md to the page URL.
facts.quote: Markdown versions of documentation pages are available by appending `.md` to the page URL.

facts.fact: The complete documentation index for learn.chatgpt.com is published at llms.txt.
facts.quote: For the complete documentation index, see [llms.txt](https://learn.chatgpt.com/llms.txt).

facts.fact: The Quickstart page says users can start using ChatGPT on the web or in the desktop app.
facts.quote: Start using ChatGPT on the web or in the desktop app.

facts.fact: The ChatGPT desktop app is available for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
facts.quote: The ChatGPT desktop app is available for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

facts.fact: ChatGPT on the web requires no installation.
facts.quote: Web Work on complex tasks uninterrupted in the cloud.No installation required

facts.fact: The page labels the desktop app as the recommended surface for ChatGPT.
facts.quote: Desktop app Work across projects, local files, and long-running tasks.Recommended

facts.fact: ChatGPT can read and modify files in the folder the user selects in the desktop app.
facts.quote: ChatGPT can read and modify files in the folder you choose.

facts.fact: In the web version, the Chat mode is for asking questions and exploring ideas conversationally, while the Work mode is for research, analysis, and creating documents, presentations, spreadsheets, Sites, or other finished work.
facts.quote: Select Chat to ask questions, explore ideas, and work through a topic conversationally.
